title: How is Hitler connected to Mr. Bean?
description:
Six real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Mr. Bean, through Daladier, Léon Blum, Churchill, Queen Elizabeth II and Rowan Atkinson.

Adolf Hitler → Édouard Daladier → Léon Blum → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Rowan Atkinson → Mr. Bean

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Édouard Daladier: In 1938, France's Édouard Daladier signed the Munich deal with Hitler.
   Photo by Bundesarchiv, Bild 183-R69173 / CC-BY-SA 3.0, CC BY-SA 3.0 de: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-R69173,_M%C3%BCnchener_Abkommen,_Staatschefs.jpg
2. Édouard Daladier → Léon Blum: In 1936, Daladier rallied in Paris beside Prime Minister Léon Blum.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Manifestation_du_Rassemblement_Populaire_au_14_juillet_-_la_tribune_officielle_-_M.M._L%C3%A9on_Blum,_Delbos,_Daladier,_Thorez,_Salengro,_Spinasse,_Violette,_Cot_etc..._-_btv1b9045892z.jpg
3. Léon Blum → Winston Churchill: In 1939, Blum had lunch with Winston Churchill at his country home.
   Photo by Anonymous (Keystone-France), Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:L%C3%A9on_Blum_et_Winston_Churchill.jpg
4. Winston Churchill → Queen Elizabeth II: In 1945, Churchill celebrated victory beside a young Princess Elizabeth.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Special_Film_Project_186_-_Buckingham_Palace_2.jpg
5. Queen Elizabeth II → Rowan Atkinson: In 2012, the Queen met Rowan Atkinson at a Dickens party.
   Photo by WPA Pool / Getty Images (via The National), Fair use (commentary): https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/us-news/2022/09/08/queen-elizabeth-ii-meets-celebrities-in-pictures
6. Rowan Atkinson → Mr. Bean: And in 1990, Rowan Atkinson first became Mr. Bean.
   Photo by Eva Rinaldi, Universal Pictures / Working Title Films (via IMP Awards), CC BY-SA 2.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rowan_Atkinson,_2011.jpg + http://www.impawards.com/2007/mr_beans_holiday_ver5.html

Research notes: The only photos of Daladier with King George VI, from the 1938 state visit and the King's 1939 trip to the front, survive as watermarked agency prints, so the chain leaves Daladier through his 1936 Popular Front rally with Léon Blum instead.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #mrbean #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: After France fell, the Vichy regime put Édouard Daladier and Léon Blum on trial together at Riom in 1942, and both men were then held prisoner by the Nazis until 1945.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
